preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for line in stdin.splitlines() for c in line)
preconditions.description: All characters in both maps are lowercase Latin letters (a-z).

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == N + M + 1 and all(len(line) == M for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:N+1]) and all(len(line) == N for line in stdin.splitlines()[N+2:])
preconditions.description: Input consists of N+M+1 lines: first line is N and M, next N lines are the first map (N rows of M chars), and next M lines are the second map (M rows of N chars).
Grid dimensions satisfy 1 ≤ N ≤ 2000, 1 ≤ M ≤ 200, and M ≤ N.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == f'{i} {j}' and 1 <= i <= N - M + 1 and 1 <= j <= N - M + 1
postconditions.description: Output is two space-separated integers i and j (1-based) representing the top-left corner of the M×M section in the first map (row i) and the second map (column j).

postconditions.expression: all(stdin.splitlines()[i + k][j1:j1 + M] == stdin.splitlines()[N + 2 + k][j + j1:j + j1 + M] for k in range(M) for j1 in range(M))
postconditions.description: The M×M section starting at row i in the first map (rows i to i+M-1, columns j to j+M-1) matches the M×M section in the second map (rows 1 to M, columns j to j+M-1) when the second map is rotated 90° clockwise and aligned such that its first row becomes the first column of the rotated section.

postconditions.expression: all(stdin.splitlines()[i + k][j + l] == stdin.splitlines()[N + 2 + l][j + k] for k in range(M) for l in range(M))
postconditions.description: The M×M section starting at row i in the first map (rows i to i+M-1, columns j to j+M-1) matches the M×M section in the second map (columns j to j+M-1, rows 1 to M) when the second map is transposed and aligned.
